findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_bulk_whatsapp_links, get_whatsapp_rates, get_whatsapp_limits · Private data: generate_bulk_whatsapp_links, get_whatsapp_limits · Public sink: generate_bulk_whatsapp_links, build_whatsapp_share_widget, get_whatsapp_limits · Destructive: validate_phone_number.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_bulk_whatsapp_links, get_whatsapp_rates, get_whatsapp_limits · Private data: generate_bulk_whatsapp_links, get_whatsapp_limits · Public sink: generate_bulk_whatsapp_links, build_whatsapp_share_widget, get_whatsapp_limits · Destructive: validate_phone_number

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
